stem: A small dark fly is found near moist container media. Which next observation most improves identification instead of relying on location alone?
choices: Record body and wing characters, inspect the media for larvae, and compare the specimen with fungus-gnat look-alikes such as shore flies.
Assume fungus gnat because every small fly near media is the same pest.
Apply a treatment before checking the insect or media.
Use leaf chlorosis alone to identify the adult fly.
rationale: Fungus-gnat identification is strengthened by adult morphology and larval/media evidence; location near moist media is useful context but is not sufficient by itself.
